藏品名称_EN: A copper drum in the shape of Asae
描述_EN: Bronze drums of the Majiang type used by the mountainous minorities of Guangxi and Guizhou provinces in southern China. Bronze drums are still played in rituals today. The shape is the final stage of the transition of the bronze drum. There are many examples in museums in southern China and more than 20 examples in Japan. Imported as early as the Edo period, it was also known in Japan as "Zhuge Liang's campanile drum" and is apparently considered to be different from the ancient bronze drums of the Middle Kingdom. This example belongs to the middle stage of the Majiang-type bronze drums.
描述_ZN: 中国南部广西省和贵州省的山区少数民族使用的马江型铜鼓。 铜鼓至今仍在祭祀活动中演奏。 形状为铜鼓过渡的最后阶段。 在中国南方的博物馆里有许多例子，在日本有20多个例子。 早在江户时代就被进口，在日本也被称为 "诸葛亮的营盘鼓"，显然，它被认为与中原地区的古代铜鼓不同。 本例属于马江型铜鼓的中期阶段。
